strings.settings.illust_instructions:
Choose Save originals / ZIP in the work menu. Save all images, select previews, or enter page numbers (e.g. 1,3,5-8). Originals are unchanged. Saving without a ZIP creates a folder.

Ugoira can be exported as looping GIFs with 256 colors, up to 2,000 frames and 4 million pixels per frame.

Downloads use the module's proxy. The save location stays on this device and is not backed up.

On Android 8–9, Pixiv needs storage access for the default folder. Text comes from the loaded reader; PDF images use the module proxy.

Notifications appear under Pixiv. On Android 13 and later, allow Pixiv to send notifications. You can always cancel tasks here.
Interrupted original, ZIP and GIF downloads can resume. Creating ZIPs and converting GIFs starts over. Older records without a work ID cannot open a work or resume a download.

strings.web_viewing.title: Web R-18 / R-18G settings
strings.web_viewing.hint: Read and update the current Pixiv web account's viewing restrictions.
strings.web_viewing.help: Uses Pixiv's WebView login session, which may differ from your app or browser account. Changes are saved to that web account, not a local filter. No login cookies or settings are backed up. If the session is unavailable, log in through Pixiv's in-app web page first, then refresh. Requests use the module proxy. Existing pages may need refreshing after saving.
strings.web_viewing.dependency: Enabling R-18G also enables R-18; disabling R-18 disables both. Pixiv may also enable sensitive content when enabling age-restricted works.

strings.web_viewing.age: Only accounts confirmed as 18 or older can change these options. Set your date of birth on the official website if it is missing; age restrictions are not bypassed.
strings.web_viewing.failed: Could not read or save web settings. Check the network, module proxy and web login, then refresh. No successful save has been confirmed.
strings.web_viewing.session: The web session or account settings changed. Refresh before trying again.
strings.web_viewing.verify: The save could not be verified. The account may already have changed; refresh or check the official website before trying again.
strings.slim.bottom_hint: Choose which main bottom navigation entries to hide.
strings.slim.keep_one: Keep at least one bottom navigation entry.
strings.slim.bottom_help: Disabled by default. Home, Search, Following new works, Notifications and My page can be hidden individually. At least one entry is kept, including after restoring incompatible settings. Hiding the selected tab switches to an available entry. This does not remove pages or change sidebar settings.
strings.slim.my_page_hint: Hide entries on My page opened from the main bottom navigation, not user profile pages.
strings.slim.my_page_help: Disabled by default, with no entries hidden initially. Account information, View profile and Settings remain available. Choose rows, the Premium button or Upload button to hide. After changing options, leave My page and enter it again; restarting Pixiv may be needed if the page is retained. Section headings and spacing may remain. Only the Pixiv 6.192.1 Compose mapping is currently supported; unknown versions keep the original page. Sidebar and user profile pages are unchanged.
